newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Prima unit raises authorised capital.
newsitem.headline: Prima unit raises authorised capital.

text.p: Prima Ltd of Singapore said on Tuesday that its wholly owned subsidiary, Prima Food Services Pte Ltd (PFS), has increased its authorised capital to S$14 million from S$9.0 million.
The company said in a statement it increased the capital by the creation of an additional five million shares valued at S$1 each.
PFS last month had raised its issued and paid-up capital to S$13.12 million from S$7.72 million.
A subsidiary of PFS, Confectionery Transformation Pte Ltd (CT), also increased its authorised capital to S$11 million from S$6.0 million through creation of five million shares worth S$1 each.
PFS has increased its shareholdings in the capital of CT to 10.20 million shares from 4.80 million shares.
